name: Sogawa Atsuko
source:
Tooru's homeroom teacher during his school days. She was respected as a kind and fair teacher.

She retired from the school when her husband was transferred to another city. Since her husband is a workaholic, she spends most of her time alone and feels lonely in an unfamiliar city. Just when her heart is weak, she runs into Tooru, who has come to Tokyo by chance.

She has a plump, fat body that stimulates the fantasies of Tooru and his classmates. She likes to take care of younger boys, and when she sees a boy in distress, she wants to wrap her arms around him and encourage him. 

She sees through Tooru's desire to be a child, and decides to give him an adult “extracurricular lesson” with her own body.

[From [url=http://www.cattleyasoft.com/cat11/character.html]official site[/url]]
